description: Runs heuristic risk checks on a token address: is it a known canonical token, is it actually a contract, does it have DexScreener liquidity, how old is the deepest pair. Returns a list of flags from `info` → `danger`. Mainnet recommended (DexScreener doesn't index testnet).

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

name: check_token
title: Risk check for an ERC-20 token
